findings.evidence: Lines 95–97 define the predicate via pairwise distances, while lines 101–109 prove only `IsUniformlyLocallyConnected →` the bounded-diameter formulation.
findings.fix: Add an `IsUniformlyLocallyConnected` iff theorem (or matching introduction theorem) for the bounded `diam C ≤ ε` formulation, plus a public `_def` restatement if the iff uses a different name.
findings.issue: The advertised diameter phrasing is only an elimination theorem, so users with the standard bounded-diameter formulation cannot establish `IsUniformlyLocallyConnected` without unfolding its body.

findings.evidence: The declaration at lines 112–113 is an unconditional canonical value for the predicate on `∅` but has no automation annotation.
findings.issue: The empty-set normal-form lemma lacks `@[simp]`, so simplification does not discharge `IsUniformlyLocallyConnected ∅`.

summary: The core definition lacks a bidirectional characteristic API, and its empty-set normal form is not registered for simplification.
